title: Essex Collection Hand Towel Bar, 6.65-Inch Wall Mount, Solid Brass, Multiple Finish Options | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your sink area with a wall mount hand towel bar crafted from solid brass, designed to keep hand towels and washcloths within easy reach in a traditional, refined look.

  • Essex collection styling: coordinate with matching Essex pieces for classic bath accessories
  • Solid brass construction: built for enduring everyday use
  • Wall mount design: saves floor space while keeping towels accessible
  • Finish flexibility: available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors
  • Included hardware: mounting hardware included; no assembly required

Specifications

  • Category: Towel Bars (hand towel holder)
  • Overall length: 6.65 in
  • Height: 2.1 in
  • Projection: 3.39 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 in
  • Weight capacity: 5 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall Mount
  • Made in the USA
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Essex Hand Towel Holder
_previous.description: This elegantly crafted wall mounted guest towel holder will add style and convenience to your bathroom décor. This guest towel holder will keep your towels within reach of the sink where they are needed. It's designed ideally for hand towels and washcloths.
